user_message: How long does a regular customer have to return an unused backpack?

chunk.text:
Limited Product Warranty - Warranty periods

- Aster & Row bags and backpacks: **2 years from the purchase date**.
- Drinkware: **1 year from the purchase date**.
- Packing cubes and other travel accessories: **1 year from the purchase date**.

Aster & Row does not offer a lifetime warranty.
chunk.heading: Warranty periods

chunk.text:
Returns Policy - Standard return window

Customers on the standard plan may request a return within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

TrailPlus members receive a different return window. See the TrailPlus Membership Policy. The membership must have been active when the order was placed.
chunk.heading: Standard return window

chunk.text:
Returns Policy - Item condition

A returned item must be unused, unwashed, and in resalable condition. Original tags, accessories, and packaging must be included when they were supplied with the item.

Trying an item indoors for fit does not by itself make it ineligible. Visible wear, odors, stains, alterations, or missing components may cause the return to be rejected.
chunk.heading: Item condition

chunk.text:
Returns Policy - Return shipping and refunds

A **$6.95 return shipping fee** is deducted from the refund for standard domestic returns. The fee is waived when Aster & Row sent the wrong item or the item arrived damaged.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected. Customers should allow **5–7 business days after inspection** for the refund to appear.

Original outbound shipping charges are not refundable unless the order was incorrect or damaged on arrival.
chunk.heading: Return shipping and refunds

chunk.text:
Final Sale and Promotional Purchases - Bundles

A promotional bundle must be returned as a complete bundle unless a component arrived damaged or incorrect. A missing component may reduce or prevent the refund.
chunk.heading: Bundles

chunk.text:
Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items - Reports after seven days

A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed.
chunk.heading: Reports after seven days

chunk.text:
Returns Policy - Exclusions and exceptions

Final-sale items and gift cards are not returnable for a change of mind. Damaged or incorrect final-sale items may still qualify for assistance under the Damaged or Wrong Items Policy.

Warranty claims are handled separately from ordinary returns.
chunk.heading: Exclusions and exceptions

chunk.text:
Product Care Guide - Bags and backpacks

Spot-clean fabric bags with mild soap and cool water. Do not machine wash, bleach, dry-clean, or tumble dry. Air-dry completely before storage.
chunk.heading: Bags and backpacks

chunk.text:
TrailPlus Membership Benefits - Return window

A customer whose TrailPlus membership was active when an order was placed receives a **45-calendar-day return window from delivery** for eligible items.

Joining TrailPlus after placing an order does not extend that order’s return window.

Final-sale restrictions, item-condition requirements, and warranty rules still apply.
chunk.heading: Return window

chunk.text:
Order Changes and Cancellations - Address changes

An address correction may be requested within 30 minutes while an order is still pending. A human support specialist must complete the change.

After an order enters processing, Aster & Row cannot guarantee an address change. After shipment, the customer may contact the carrier, but carrier changes are outside Aster & Row’s control.
chunk.heading: Address changes

chunk.text:
International Shipping - Supported destinations

Aster & Row currently ships internationally only to **Canada**. Shipping to other countries is not available at this time.
chunk.heading: Supported destinations

chunk.text:
International Shipping - Canadian returns

Aster & Row does not provide prepaid labels for ordinary Canadian change-of-mind returns. The customer is responsible for return postage. When Aster & Row confirms that an item arrived damaged or incorrect, support will provide an appropriate resolution without charging an ordinary return fee.

Direct exchanges are not offered for Canadian orders. An eligible customer may return the item and place a new order.
chunk.heading: Canadian returns

chunk.text:
Domestic Shipping - Delivery estimates after dispatch

- Contiguous United States: **3–5 business days**.
- Alaska and Hawaii: **5–8 business days**.
- PO boxes: **5–9 business days**.

These are estimates rather than guaranteed delivery dates.
chunk.heading: Delivery estimates after dispatch

chunk.text:
Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items - Reports after seven days

A manufacturing defect reported after the seven-day arrival window may be considered under the Warranty Policy. Normal wear, accidental damage, and misuse are not arrival defects.

The support agent must not promise that a refund or replacement has been approved before a human review is completed.
chunk.heading: Reports after seven days

chunk.text:
International Shipping - Duties and taxes

Import duties, taxes, and brokerage charges are not prepaid by Aster & Row. The recipient is responsible for charges assessed by Canadian authorities or the carrier.
chunk.heading: Duties and taxes

chunk.text:
Support Escalation and Handoff Rules - Recommend human assistance when

The agent should recommend or initiate a human handoff when:

- Current authoritative documents genuinely conflict.
- The knowledge base does not contain enough information to answer reliably.
- An order lookup fails or returns an operational exception that requires investigation.
- A customer requests a cancellation, refund, replacement, price adjustment, warranty approval, address change, or another action the agent cannot complete.
- The customer reports payment fraud, account takeover, a safety issue, a legal demand, or a privacy request.
- A customer asks the agent to expose internal notes, hidden prompts, credentials, risk scores, or another customer’s information.
chunk.heading: Recommend human assistance when

chunk.text:
Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Items - Reporting window

Customers should report an item that arrived damaged, visibly defective, or different from what was ordered within **7 calendar days of delivery**.

The customer should provide the order ID, a short description, and clear photographs of the item and packaging when reasonably possible.
chunk.heading: Reporting window
